artifacts.notes: The 1024 by 737 pixel photograph was visually inspected. It shows a fixed, high-backed episcopal seat elevated by three steps beneath a canopy, with attendant seats beside it. The witness strongly matches the Caeremoniale's broad throne morphology but does not make its particular marble, arms, heraldry, curtains, or attendant chairs universal.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Library of Congress record states that HABS image HABS MD,4-BALT,41--4 was made by the U.S. Government and has no known restrictions; the identified image is not a copy from another source.

work.author: Historic American Buildings Survey
work.description: Lanny Miyamoto's October 1958 HABS photograph of the archbishop's throne in the Roman Catholic Cathedral of Baltimore. It is a dated architectural witness within the 1962 horizon, not a universal prescription for episcopal seating.
work.title: Roman Catholic Cathedral of Baltimore: Archbishop's Throne
